Prevention: Cultural practices, hoeing up to one month of sowing of crops.
Monitoring: Pest scouting twice a week after start of fruiting.
Weather conditions are favourable at 20°C and above.
Check for infected fruits and maggots in the fruits; maggots are white in colour.
Observe flying adults on the plants; adults are reddish brown in colour.
Install pheromone traps to check the pest status.
Apply direct controls if 2-5 infected fruits are found out of one hundred fruits.
Direct Control: Cue lure traps in field @ 8/acre and change after 15 days.
Restrictions: Number of sprays dependent on pest attack; use recommended measures on label.
